title: 空中看美国
creator: Yann Arthus-Bertrand
note: 直升机低空航拍把美国的几何田野与城市肌理变成抽象图案，全球最畅销航拍书「从空中看地球」的美洲卷。
noteEn: Low-altitude aerial views turn American farmland and city grids into abstract geometry — the America volume of the world's best-selling "Earth from the Air."

title: 凯斯研究住宅22号（斯塔尔住宅）
creator: Julius Shulman
note: 玻璃盒悬在洛杉矶夜空的经典一瞬，定义了现代主义住宅的「山顶神话」，20世纪被引用最多的建筑照片之一。
noteEn: The glass box floating over Los Angeles at night — the image that defined modernism's hilltop myth and one of the most reproduced architecture photos of the 20th century.

title: TWA航站楼
creator: Ezra Stoller
note: 用中画幅把沙里宁的混凝土翼楼拍成白色鸟翼的流体雕塑，建筑摄影与建筑本身从此互相成就。
noteEn: Medium-format precision turns Saarinen's concrete wings into a fluid white bird — the shot that made architectural photography inseparable from architecture.

title: 马赛公寓
creator: Lucien Hervé
note: 勒·柯布西耶的御用摄影师，用强烈黑白明暗与俯仰角度把混凝土粗野主义拍出雕塑般的节奏。
noteEn: Le Corbusier's house photographer, whose stark blacks and bold angles give raw concrete a sculptural rhythm.

title: 水塔
creator: Bernd & Hilla Becher
note: 同一正面视角拍遍欧洲工业水塔，「类型学」自此成为摄影方法，也是杜塞尔多夫学派的起点。
noteEn: Identical frontal views of industrial water towers across Europe founded the typology method and the Düsseldorf School.

title: 建筑（模糊系列）
creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
note: 故意失焦把地标建筑还原成记忆中的模糊剪影，让建筑照片变成关于「看见」本身的冥想。
noteEn: Deliberate defocus reduces landmarks to blurred memory-traces — architecture as a meditation on seeing itself.

title: 都柏林圣三一学院图书馆
creator: Candida Höfer
note: 无人空间的宏大堂内景观，对称、静谧、色彩精准，让公共建筑的秩序之美自己说话。
noteEn: Vast, people-free interiors of public institutions — symmetry, silence and exact color let order speak for itself.

title: 无意识之地
creator: Thomas Struth
note: 正面平视的城市立面排比，把街道拍成心理档案，杜塞尔多夫学派冷静客观的典范。
noteEn: Flat, deadpan facade typologies turn streets into psychological archives — the cool objectivity of the Düsseldorf School.

title: 莱茵河2号
creator: Andreas Gursky
note: 数字抹除厂房后的极简莱茵河，2011年以430万美元成交，曾是全球最贵照片。
noteEn: A digitally purified Rhine, stripped of factories into minimal horizontals — sold for $4.3M in 2011, then the most expensive photo ever.

title: 贝鲁特
creator: Gabriele Basilico
note: 内战废墟上冷静的战后城市肖像，大画幅把创伤拍成克制而有尊严的测绘图。
noteEn: Dispassionate large-format portraits of a post-civil-war city, dignifying ruin with the discipline of a survey.

title: 大卫塔
creator: Iwan Baan
note: 委内瑞拉未完工摩天楼被数千居民自建改造的垂直社区，让「建筑」从设计走向真实生活。
noteEn: An unfinished Caracas skyscraper turned self-built vertical village — architecture as lived reality, not render.

title: 罗马MAXXI美术馆
creator: Hélène Binet
note: 只用胶片和自然光拍扎哈的流动混凝土曲面，把建筑细部抽象成光与影的素描。
noteEn: Film and natural light alone render Zaha's flowing concrete as a drawing in light and shadow.

title: 洪水之后
creator: Robert Polidori
note: 飓风卡特里娜后新奥尔良民居的霉菌墙面，大画幅把灾难痕迹拍成静物般庄严的遗存。
noteEn: Katrina-ravaged New Orleans interiors, the moldy walls shot large-format into solemn still lifes of loss.

title: 人造风景
creator: Edward Burtynsky
note: 采石场、煤矿与集装箱港口的巨幅俯视，让工业破坏呈现出近乎美的震撼尺度。
noteEn: Huge views of quarries, mines and ports make industrial destruction almost beautiful in scale.

title: 密度建筑
creator: Michael Wolf
note: 正面压缩香港公屋外立面的重复窗格，把高密度居住拍成令人窒息的秩序图案。
noteEn: Front-on compression of Hong Kong housing facades turns density into a suffocating grid of repetition.

title: 失落的前卫
creator: Richard Pare
note: 逐栋记录苏联构成主义建筑的危楼遗存，很多建筑在他拍摄后即被拆除，成为救赎性的档案。
noteEn: A survey of surviving Soviet Constructivist buildings, many demolished right after he shot them — a redemptive archive.

title: 老巴黎
creator: Eugène Atget
note: 在大拆建前记录中世纪巴黎的街巷与店面，被超现实主义者奉为先知，纪实与艺术在此交汇。
noteEn: Documenting medieval Paris before the wrecking ball — adopted by the Surrealists as a prophet of documentary art.

title: 巴西利亚
creator: Marcel Gautherot
note: 记录尼迈耶新首都拔地而起的曲线，混凝土被拍得轻盈如纸，巴西现代主义的视觉圣像。
noteEn: Niemeyer's new capital rising in concrete made to look paper-light — the visual icon of Brazilian modernism.

title: 流水别墅
creator: Bill Hedrich (Hedrich-Blessing)
note: 赖特悬在瀑布上的名宅，1937年的经典影像让「有机建筑」理念成为全美焦点。
noteEn: The iconic 1937 view of Wright's house over the waterfall — the image that made organic architecture famous.

title: 住宅（类型学系列）
creator: Thomas Ruff
note: 德国平庸民居的正面照被放大到极致，让「无聊」本身成为值得凝视的主题。
noteEn: Blown-up frontal views of banal German homes, elevating boredom itself into a subject worth staring at.

title: 熔点
creator: Stéphane Couturier
note: 汽车工厂内部被拆解重组成马赛克般的几何抽象，工业建筑转化为像素化图像。
noteEn: Car-factory interiors dissected into mosaic-like abstraction, industrial architecture turned pixelated image.

title: 全谱优势
creator: Simon Norfolk
note: 德国美军基地被拍成迷彩般的彩绘城，把「军事建筑即景观」这一逻辑推到极致。
noteEn: US bases in Germany become camouflage-painted cityscapes — military architecture as landscape, pushed to its end.

title: 朵维玛与大象
creator: Richard Avedon
note: 巴黎马戏团里黑衣模特在两头大象间的定格，被评为一世纪最重要的时尚照片之一。
noteEn: A black-gowned model frozen between circus elephants in Paris — voted one of the century's defining fashion images.

title: 大裸体
creator: Helmut Newton
note: 超大尺幅、高跟鞋与权力的对峙，把时尚摄影推向挑衅与欲望的边界。
noteEn: Oversized, high-heeled and confrontational — fashion photography pushed to the edge of provocation and desire.

title: 美人鱼礼服
creator: Irving Penn
note: 丽莎·冯萨格里斯身穿紧身鱼尾礼服，严谨构图与雕塑感剪影奠定工作室时尚摄影范式。
noteEn: Lisa Fonssagrives in a form-fitting evening gown — precise composition and sculpted silhouette define studio fashion.

title: 弗拉姆博亚
creator: Viviane Sassen
note: 非洲炽烈阳光下几何化的身体与影子，让时尚摄影有了观念艺术的锐度。
noteEn: Bodies and shadows reduced to geometry in harsh African sun — fashion with the edge of conceptual art.

title: 查尔斯·乔丹广告
creator: Guy Bourdin
note: 高跟鞋广告拍成叙事悬疑的超现实静物，模糊商品与噩梦的界限，改写广告美学。
noteEn: Shoe ads staged as surreal narrative stills, blurring product and nightmare — a rewrite of advertising aesthetics.

title: 麦当娜《Sex》
creator: Steven Meisel
note: 把流行天后铸成挑衅与审美试验的载体，1992年文化事件级时尚写真集。
noteEn: The pop queen remade as provocation and aesthetic experiment — a culture-event fashion book of 1992.

title: 超级名模
creator: Peter Lindbergh
note: 不化妆的名模群像在海滩拍成黑白快照，终结了80年代浓妆风潮，开启「超模时代」。
noteEn: Unretouched, makeup-free supermodels on a beach — it ended the '80s gloss and opened the supermodel era.

title: 克劳迪娅·希弗的Guess广告
creator: Ellen von Unwerth
note: 把牛仔广告拍成即兴、俏皮、带欲望意味的「窥视」，模特本人成为镜头前最亮眼的主角。
noteEn: Jeans ads shot as playful, voyeuristic improvisation that made the model the star of her own film.

title: 第三个爱之夏
creator: Corinne Day
note: 租屋里的凯特·摩丝穿着薄衫，以真实、粗颗粒、近乎纪实的语言打破华丽时尚。
noteEn: A teenage Kate Moss in a rented flat, shot raw and grainy — grunge realism that shattered glossy fashion.

title: 试镜
creator: Juergen Teller
note: 用傻瓜相机拍模特们的「海选」照，不修片、不摆pose，把时尚拉回素人状态。
noteEn: Point-and-shoot casting photos, unretouched and unposed — fashion dragged back to the amateur present.

title: 曼波彻束腰
creator: Horst P. Horst
note: 背对镜头的模特束腰曲线如古典雕塑，是《Vogue》黄金时代最著名的时尚影像之一。
noteEn: A model's back in a Mainbocher corset, sculptural as a Greek statue — one of Vogue's golden-age icons.

title: 洪水（拉沙佩勒）
creator: David LaChapelle
note: 奢华与末日在艳俗色彩里同框，让时尚摄影成为批判消费主义的寓言。
noteEn: Luxury and apocalypse share one garish frame — fashion photography as a fable against consumerism.

title: SHOWstudio
creator: Nick Knight
note: 首个把时尚影像直播化、实验化的平台，让摄影与动态影像、科技持续交锋。
noteEn: The first platform to broadcast and experiment with fashion imagery live — where photography meets film and tech.

title: 说书人
creator: Tim Walker
note: 手工置景的童话奇观，超大裙摆与超现实道具在胶片里复活维多利亚式幻想。
noteEn: Hand-built fairytale tableaux where oversized gowns and surreal props revive Victorian fantasy on film.

title: 迪士尼梦境肖像
creator: Annie Leibovitz
note: 把明星扮进童话名场面，高预算时装叙事与流行文化的交汇之作。
noteEn: Stars staged into fairy-tale tableaux — where high-budget fashion storytelling meets pop culture.

title: 范思哲礼服，埃尔米拉日
creator: Herb Ritts
note: 沙漠里露背礼服与极简天空形成经典剪影，把时装拍成希腊雕塑般的身体颂歌。
noteEn: A backless gown against desert and sky — fashion turned into a Grecian sculptural ode to the body.

title: 浴场
creator: Deborah Turbeville
note: 粗颗粒、虚焦、苍白的泳装故事，像被遗忘的旧照片，预言了时尚摄影的情绪转向。
noteEn: Grainy, soft-focus, faded swimwear story that looks like forgotten photographs — foretelling fashion's emotional turn.

title: 卡夏尔广告
creator: Sarah Moon
note: 柔焦与流动的纱裙把广告拍成梦境，女性摄影师以「朦胧」对抗时装工业的硬朗。
noteEn: Soft focus and drifting chiffon turn an ad into a dream — a female gaze of haze against fashion's hardness.

title: 凯特·摩丝 · CK Obsession
creator: Mario Sorrenti
note: 卧室里黑白近摄的摩丝写真，把「真实」包装成90年代最有力的香水广告。
noteEn: Intimate black-and-white close-ups of Moss in bed — authenticity packaged as the decade's most powerful perfume ad.

title: 碧昂丝 · Vogue封面
creator: Tyler Mitchell
note: 26岁成为Vogue创刊126年来首位拍摄封面的黑人摄影师，用田园阳光改写时尚权力地图。
noteEn: At 26, the first Black photographer to shoot a Vogue cover in its 126-year history — sunlit, pastoral, redefining fashion's power map.

title: 视觉
creator: 陈漫 Chen Man
note: 数码后期与东方视觉符号混融的时装大片，开创中国时尚摄影的「视觉系」语言。
noteEn: Digital retouching fused with Eastern visual symbols — the "visionary" language that opened Chinese fashion photography.

title: 格蕾丝·琼斯 · 加勒比女王
creator: Jean-Paul Goude
note: 把歌手塑造成黑白剪影、夸张身体的「图腾」，预演了后现代身份扮演的图像学。
noteEn: The singer carved into a black-and-white totem of exaggerated body — prescient iconography of postmodern identity play.

title: 月升，埃尔南德斯
creator: Ansel Adams
note: 在光线转瞬即逝里凭「预视」拍下的月升，是安塞尔·亚当斯区域曝光法的完美例证。
noteEn: A moonrise captured on instinct through "previsualization" — the perfect proof of Adams' zone system.

title: 凝视
creator: Frans Lanting
note: 低角度把野生动物拍成与人类平视的个体，黑白影棚式肖像赋予它们尊严与性格。
noteEn: Studio-like, low-angle portraits that meet wild animals as equals, giving them dignity and character.

title: 雪豹
creator: Steve Winter
note: 用遥控相机在喜马拉雅夜间拍到野生雪豹正面照，完成了一次堪称奇迹的拍摄工程。
noteEn: A remote-camera night shot of a wild snow leopard in the Himalayas — a near-impossible photographic feat.

title: 寻找夏天
creator: Jim Brandenburg
note: 90天只拍90张照片的自我节制，让每一张都成为对大自然的郑重注视。
noteEn: Ninety days, just ninety exposures — restraint that turns every frame into a deliberate act of attention.

title: 野性生灵
creator: Art Wolfe
note: 用绝佳构图把动物的姿态与背景图案化，证明野生动物摄影也可以是形式艺术。
noteEn: Animals' postures composed into graphic patterns — wildlife photography as formal art.

title: 今日之获
creator: Thomas D. Mangelsen
note: 鲑鱼跃瀑直入棕熊之口的决定性瞬间，史上流传最广的野生动物照片之一。
noteEn: A spawning salmon leaping straight into a bear's jaws at Brooks Falls — one of the most circulated wildlife photos ever.

title: 极地执念
creator: Paul Nicklen
note: 极地摄影师的毕生档案，把冰下世界与北极熊拍成冷冽而亲密的存在。
noteEn: A lifetime of polar archives, rendering the under-ice world and polar bears cold and intimate.

title: 野放熊猫
creator: Ami Vitale
note: 记录人工繁育大熊猫走向野外的瞬间，保育议题从此有了温柔而有力的影像面孔。
noteEn: Captive-bred pandas stepping into the wild — conservation given a tender, powerful visual face.

title: 创世纪
creator: Sebastião Salgado
note: 八年奔走全球寻找未经文明触碰之地，用大画幅黑白为地球留下「创世记」档案。
noteEn: Eight years seeking the planet's pristine places — a large-format black-and-white Genesis archive of Earth.

title: 在这片土地上，阴影降临
en: On This Earth, A Shadow Falls
creator: Nick Brandt
note: 东非动物站在人类改造的风景里如肖像般凝视，把生态哀歌拍成庄严肃穆的黑白剧。
noteEn: East African animals posed like human portraits amid altered land — an ecological elegy as solemn black-and-white drama.

title: 虎之年
creator: Michael Nichols
note: 与印度科学家用自动相机拍到野生孟加拉虎，为大型猫科动物建立了可亲近的影像。
noteEn: Remote cameras in India capturing wild Bengal tigers — making the big cats approachable on the page.

title: 水、光、时间
creator: David Doubilet
note: 国家地理水摄泰斗的精选，证明海面之下同样有着剧场般的秩序与颜色。
noteEn: Nat Geo's master of underwater photography shows the sea holds its own theater of order and color.

title: 海洋之魂
creator: Brian Skerry
note: 二十年潜入全球海域的鲸豚档案，把海洋生物拍成需要被保护的「人物」。
noteEn: Two decades of whale and dolphin imagery — ocean life portrayed as characters worthy of protection.

title: 塞伦盖蒂间谍
creator: Anup Shah
note: 用遥控相机把镜头贴进狮群，让草原之王卸下防备，露出近乎家庭化的日常。
noteEn: Remote cameras placed inside the pride make the kings of the savanna drop their guard into near-family scenes.

title: 极乐鸟
creator: Tim Laman & Ed Scholes
note: 走遍新几内亚为所有极乐鸟物种建立影像档案，堪称鸟类摄影的「物种大全」。
noteEn: Crossing New Guinea to archive every bird-of-paradise species — an almost complete inventory of one bird family.

title: 影像方舟
creator: Joel Sartore
note: 为全球物种建立黑白棚拍肖像库，用「方舟」隐喻回应第六次大灭绝。
noteEn: Studio portraits of Earth's species against black and white — an ark against the sixth extinction.

title: 金丝猴
creator: Marsel van Oosten
note: 中国滇金丝猴与环境融为一体的构图，斩获索尼世界摄影奖野生动物类大奖。
noteEn: A Yunnan snub-nosed monkey fused into its landscape — winner of Sony World Photography's wildlife prize.

title: 战火中的大猩猩
creator: Brent Stirton
note: 刚果战乱中被杀害的山地大猩猩被士兵抬出，获2008年荷赛年度照片。
noteEn: Dead mountain gorillas carried from Congo's conflict — World Press Photo of the Year 2008.

title: 雪豹 · 青藏
creator: Vincent Munier
note: 在青藏高原风雪中用长焦守候雪豹，把濒危猛兽拍成天地间一抹极简的灰影。
noteEn: Long-lens vigils in the Tibetan highlands render the endangered cat a wisp of gray in a vast white world.

title: 世上最古老的生灵
en: The Oldest Living Things in the World
creator: Rachel Sussman
note: 为树龄数千年的个体生命建档，用摄影丈量时间尺度，也让「活体」有了肖像。
noteEn: Archiving organisms thousands of years old — photography measuring deep time, giving ancient life a portrait.

title: 鹦鹉螺
creator: Edward Weston
note: 一颗螺壳被拍成螺旋的完美几何，现代主义把「直接摄影」推向造型的极致。
noteEn: A single shell distilled into perfect spiral geometry — modernist "straight photography" at its sculptural peak.

title: 荒野蕴藏着世界的救赎
en: In Wildness Is the Preservation of the World
creator: Eliot Porter
note: 新英格兰森林的彩色特写与梭罗箴言并置，是最早把彩色用于严肃自然的书籍之一。
noteEn: Color close-ups of New England woods paired with Thoreau — among the first books to take color nature seriously.

title: 山之光
creator: Galen Rowell
note: 登山者的视角与「等待最佳光线」的哲学，让风光摄影成为一场与时间的赛跑。
noteEn: A climber's eye and a wait-for-the-light philosophy make landscape a race against time.

title: 优胜美地谷
creator: Carleton Watkins
note: 湿版大画幅第一次让美国西部荒野震撼国会，直接促成优胜美地成为受保护公园。
noteEn: Giant wet-plate views of the West so awed Congress they helped make Yosemite a protected park.

title: 北极熊群像
creator: Roie Galitz
note: 无人机视角的北极熊群聚影像走红全球，也让气候议题以可爱又忧伤的方式被看见。
noteEn: A drone-view crowd of polar bears that went viral — climate grief delivered with charm.

title: 不止于人类
creator: Tim Flach
note: 影棚里的动物肖像被拍成拟人化的「他者」，审视人类与动物间的镜像关系。
noteEn: Studio portraits that anthropomorphize animals into "others" — a mirror held between species.

title: 腔棘鱼
creator: Laurent Ballesta
note: 潜水记录活体腔棘鱼这一「活化石」，填补了人类对该物种影像的百年空白。
noteEn: Diving to film a living coelacanth — a "living fossil" unseen alive by humans for a century.

title: 地出
creator: William Anders (Apollo 8)
note: 人类首次绕月时回望蓝白地球升起，被称作「人类历史上最具影响力的环境照片」。
noteEn: Earth rising over the lunar horizon on the first crewed Moon orbit — called the most influential environmental photo ever.

title: 暗淡蓝点
creator: NASA / Voyager 1
note: 旅行者1号在64亿公里外回望地球仅为0.12像素，萨根借此写下著名的「暗淡蓝点」。
noteEn: From 4 billion miles out, Earth is a 0.12-pixel speck — the image behind Sagan's famous "Pale Blue Dot."

title: 创生之柱
creator: NASA / ESA (Hubble)
note: 哈勃拍摄鹰状星云的恒星育婴室，成为天文摄影史上被转载最多的照片之一。
noteEn: Hubble's view of star nurseries in the Eagle Nebula — one of the most reproduced images in astronomical history.

title: 蓝色弹珠
creator: NASA (Apollo 17 crew)
note: 阿波罗17号在距地4.5万公里拍下的完整地球，至今是「地球」最具标志性的形象。
noteEn: A fully lit Earth from Apollo 17 — still the most iconic portrait of our planet ever made.

title: 哈勃超深场
creator: NASA / ESA (Hubble)
note: 对准天球极小一块累积曝光百万秒，数出约一万个星系——可见宇宙的「深场」剖面。
noteEn: A million-second exposure of a tiny patch of sky revealing ~10,000 galaxies — a core sample of the visible universe.

title: M87黑洞
creator: Event Horizon Telescope
note: 事件视界望远镜用全球射电阵列首次给黑洞拍照，橙红光环成为科学的全民符号。
noteEn: The first image of a black hole's shadow, built from a planet-wide radio array — science's viral orange ring.

title: 韦布首张深场
creator: NASA / ESA / CSA (JWST)
note: 韦布望远镜以红外之眼深挖130亿年前的星系团，宣告下一代深空时代的开启。
noteEn: The Webb telescope's infrared gaze into a 13-billion-year-old cluster, opening the next era of deep space.

title: 首张月球银版照片
creator: John W. Draper
note: 摄影术诞生仅一年后即拍下月球表面细节，天文摄影的开端。
noteEn: Lunar surface detail captured just a year after photography's invention — the dawn of astrophotography.

title: 仙女座星系
creator: Isaac Roberts
note: 首次用长时间曝光揭示仙女座星系的旋涡结构，证明摄影能看见人眼看不到的宇宙。
noteEn: Long exposure revealing Andromeda's spiral structure — proof photography sees what the eye cannot.

title: 宇宙之景
creator: David Malin
note: 用化学方法合成三色影像，把南半球星云的色彩与纤维细节首次带进大众视野。
noteEn: Three-color photographic synthesis that first brought the color and filament detail of southern nebulae to the public.

title: 夜色中的世界
creator: Tunc Tezel
note: TWAN「夜空世界」网络的核心成员，让星空与地景的摄影成为跨文化协作。
noteEn: A core member of TWAN's night-sky network — sky-and-landscape photography as cross-cultural collaboration.

title: 深空之色
creator: Rogelio Bernal Andreo
note: 用窄带滤镜把猎户座一带拍出斑斓气体细节，业余天文摄影技艺的巅峰示范。
noteEn: Narrowband filters turn the Orion region into swirls of gas and color — amateur astrophotography at its peak.

title: 空间站凌日
creator: Thierry Legault
note: 在精确计算的瞬间拍到空间站掠过日面的剪影，把「巧合」变成一门精密的科学。
noteEn: Calculating the exact second the ISS crosses the solar disk — serendipity turned into exact science.

title: 长城上的银河
en: The Milky Way above the Great Wall
creator: 戴建峰 Jeff Dai
note: 让长城与银河同框，带动了中文互联网天文摄影的爆发式普及。
noteEn: The Great Wall under a Milky Way arch — a catalyst for the explosion of Chinese astrophotography online.

title: 留尼汪火山星空
creator: Luc Perrot
note: 熔岩红与银河银在同一画面里对峙，火山口成为星空摄影最戏剧性的前景。
noteEn: Molten glow and the galactic core in one frame — an erupting crater as the most dramatic of foregrounds.

title: 巴兹·奥尔德林踏上月面
creator: Neil Armstrong (Apollo 11)
note: 人类首次登月中阿姆斯特朗为同伴拍下的影像，头盔面罩映出月球荒原与登月舱。
noteEn: Armstrong's photo of Aldrin during the first Moon walk, the visor reflecting the lunar wasteland.

title: 瑞典极光
creator: Göran Strand
note: 用全景接片把极光拱门与雪原树影收入画面，极光摄影中「环境」意识的代表。
noteEn: A full-arch aurora over snow and pines — emblematic of the environmental turn in aurora photography.

title: 北极光
creator: Ole Salomonsen
note: 挪威摄影师在极夜小镇持续数年的极光延时与静帧，把舞动的光拍成天体剧场。
noteEn: Years of aurora time-lapses and stills from a Norwegian polar town — dancing light as celestial theater.

title: 夜空景观
creator: Michael Shainblum
note: 把美国西部的银河接片与前景合成，代表了现代「夜空风景」的视觉美学。
noteEn: Milky Way panoramas fused with western US foregrounds — the look of the contemporary night-landscape wave.

title: 银河选区星图
en: Atlas of Selected Regions of the Milky Way
creator: E. E. Barnard
note: 几十年巡天的摄影星图集，首次系统展示银河暗星云的结构，天文学里程碑。
noteEn: Decades of sky photography that first charted the Milky Way's dark nebulae — a milestone of astronomy.

title: 海尔-波普彗星 · 纪念碑谷
creator: Wally Pacholka
note: 双尾彗星悬在红色砂岩孤峰之上，成为上世纪90年代末最著名的天文照片之一。
noteEn: The twin-tailed comet above red rock spires — one of the most famous astronomical images of the late '90s.

title: 1919年日全食
creator: Arthur Eddington (expedition)
note: 日食观测中恒星位置的偏移验证了广义相对论，摄影直接参与了物理学革命。
noteEn: Starlight bending during totality confirmed general relativity — photography at the heart of a physics revolution.

title: 夜巴黎
creator: Brassaï
note: 第一次系统拍摄雨夜巴黎的湿漉街巷与咖啡馆，确立了「夜间摄影」这一体裁。
noteEn: The first systematic night portrait of wet Paris streets and cafés — founding night photography as a genre.

title: 伦敦之夜
creator: Bill Brandt
note: 战前伦敦的霓虹、睡在桥下的人与剧场后台，用强烈明暗写出城市的阶层剖面。
noteEn: Pre-war neon, sleepers under bridges, theater wings — stark chiaroscuro mapping London's class divide.

title: 纽约夜景
creator: Berenice Abbott
note: 在摩天楼拔地而起的年代记录曼哈顿夜色，「变化中的纽约」项目的代表影像。
noteEn: Manhattan at night during the skyscraper boom — a signature of her "Changing New York" project.

title: 熨斗大厦
creator: Edward Steichen
note: 暮色与雪中的熨斗大厦被拍成印象派式的剪影，早期画意摄影转向现代的一步。
noteEn: The Flatiron in dusk and snow as an Impressionist silhouette — pictorialism stepping toward the modern.

title: 纽约之夜
creator: Andreas Feininger
note: LIFE杂志的摩天楼夜景，长焦压缩把曼哈顿的天际线叠成一片光的墙。
noteEn: LIFE's telephoto night shots stacking Manhattan's skyline into a wall of light.

title: 逐屋
creator: Todd Hido
note: 透过车窗外拍的美国郊区住宅，在幽蓝夜色里暧昧不安，重新定义了夜间快照。
noteEn: Suburban homes shot through a car window in uneasy blue dark — redefining the nocturnal snapshot.

title: 情歌（我的自尽）
creator: Rut Blees Luxemburg
note: 伦敦街头的长曝光把霓虹与雨水拍成抒情诗，让「城市之夜」有了哲学化的暧昧。
noteEn: Long exposures turn London's neon and rain into lyric — the urban night given philosophical ambivalence.

title: 我，东京
creator: Jacob Aue Sobol
note: 深夜东京地铁与街头的高感光黑白，把陌生都市拍成心跳般的亲密存在。
noteEn: High-ISO black-and-white of late-night Tokyo transit and streets — the alien city felt as a heartbeat.

title: 东京-横须贺
creator: Greg Girard
note: 70年代末驻日外景的霓虹夜街，在城市化前夜为日本留下一份彩色夜生活档案。
noteEn: Neon night streets of late-'70s Japan, shot before the boom — a color archive of a vanishing nightlife.

title: 黑暗之城
creator: Greg Girard & Ian Lambot
note: 深入九龙城寨的日光与夜景纪实，为已消失的「无主之城」留下最完整的影像。
noteEn: Daylight and night records of Kowloon Walled City — the most complete visual archive of the lost enclave.

title: 东京夜游
creator: Liam Wong
note: 游戏美术师出身，用赛博朋克配色把雨夜东京拍成电子游戏般的场景。
noteEn: A game designer's cyberpunk palette turns rainy Tokyo into a playable-looking cityscape.

title: 东京夜色
creator: Masashi Wakui
note: 社交媒体时代崛起的霓虹街拍，把东京后街拍成宫崎骏动画里的静谧夜景。
noteEn: Neon backstreet shots that swept social media — Tokyo as a hushed Ghibli night.

title: 西部之光
creator: Paul Zizka
note: 落基山脉的星空、极光与冰川之夜，让夜间风光摄影抵达可攀可近的现场感。
noteEn: Star-filled nights over the Canadian Rockies — night landscape made physically reachable and present.

title: 与夜相识
creator: Lynn Saville
note: 黄昏与黎明之交的城市空镜，把纽约拍成介于昼与夜之间的静谧地带。
noteEn: Cities at the border of dusk and dawn — New York as a quiet zone between day and night.

title: 格林童话景观
creator: Kilian Schönberger
note: 色盲摄影师拍出的雾林夜色，恰好呼应德国童话里神秘的森林氛围。
noteEn: A color-blind photographer's misty forest nights — perfectly matching the eerie woods of German fairy tales.

title: 维纳斯的诞生
creator: Mark Gee
note: 跳入星海的人影剪影，获2013年「年度天文摄影师」总冠军。
noteEn: A silhouette leaping into the Milky Way — overall winner of the 2013 Astronomy Photographer of the Year.

title: 赤裸城市
creator: Weegee
note: 闪光灯+夜班收音机扫街，把凶案、火灾与夜店写成纽约最赤裸的社会纪实。
noteEn: Flash and a police-band radio — crime, fire and nightlife as the rawest social record of New York.

title: 光明
creator: Rinko Kawauchi
note: 以柔焦与低饱和看城市夜光、雪花与萤火，把日常之光拍成恍惚的微光诗。
noteEn: Soft, pale views of city lights, snow and fireflies — everyday luminance as a dreamy poem of light.

title: 临近的阴影
creator: 何藩 Fan Ho
note: 黄昏香港街头的光影几何，何藩最著名的决定性瞬间之一。
noteEn: Geometric light and shadow on a Hong Kong street at dusk — one of Fan Ho's defining decisive moments.

title: 公园
creator: Kohei Yoshiyuki
note: 红外闪光记录东京公园夜里的隐秘窥视，把「观看」本身拍成不安的证据。
noteEn: Infrared flash exposes covert encounters in a Tokyo park at night — looking captured as unease itself.

title: 美国照片
creator: Walker Evans
note: 大萧条时期美国城乡的冷静实录，确立纪实摄影的美学与伦理标高。
noteEn: A dispassionate record of Depression-era America — setting the aesthetic and ethical bar for documentary.

title: 纽约（威廉·克莱因）
creator: William Klein
note: 广角、虚焦、冲撞式的街头快照，把纽约拍成喧闹的暴力拼贴。
noteEn: Wide-angle, blurry, colliding street snapshots — New York as a violent, noisy collage.

title: 美国人
creator: Robert Frank
note: 穿越美国的公路影像改写摄影语法，让「主观纪实」成为可能。
noteEn: A cross-country road vision that rewrote photography's grammar, making subjective documentary possible.

title: 地铁
creator: Bruce Davidson
note: 彩色闪光灯贴身记录纽约地铁众生相，把最拥挤的空间拍成最诚实的剧场。
noteEn: On-board flash portraits of the New York subway — the most crowded space as the most honest theater.

title: 开车看美国
creator: Lee Friedlander
note: 挡风玻璃内外叠影的美国公路，把「汽车社会」拍成不断叠加的视觉白噪音。
noteEn: Windshield-framed America, foreground and street stacked — car culture as layered visual noise.

title: 猎人
creator: Daido Moriyama
note: 粗颗粒、高反差、摇晃镜头下的日本城市，森山大道的「粗野美学」宣言。
noteEn: Grainy, high-contrast, jittery views of urban Japan — Moriyama's manifesto of the "are-bure-boke" aesthetic.

title: 挑衅（摄影杂志）
creator: 中平卓马·高梨丰·森山大道
note: 三期限定却影响深远的战后日本摄影杂志，「作为反叛的影像」运动的原点。
noteEn: A three-issue magazine that shook post-war Japanese photography — ground zero of "image as provocation."

title: 色彩之河
creator: Raghubir Singh
note: 在西方纪实仍偏爱黑白时，用徕卡拍出印度街头的饱和色彩，开创彩色街头传统。
noteEn: Saturated Leica color of Indian streets while Western documentary favored black-and-white — founder of a color street tradition.

title: 胡奇坦
creator: Graciela Iturbide
note: 墨西哥萨波特克女性的日常与庆典，混血、幽默而庄重，拉美纪实摄影的杰作。
noteEn: The daily life and festivals of Zapotec women in Oaxaca — mixed, funny and solemn Latin American documentary.

title: 纳克塔
creator: Miguel Rio Branco
note: 巴西东北部的暴力色彩与贫困身体，把纪实推向视觉冲击的极限。
noteEn: Violent color and hard-lived bodies of Brazil's northeast — documentary pushed to visceral extremes.

title: 薇薇安·迈尔街头摄影
creator: Vivian Maier
note: 保姆身份藏匿一生的街头杰作，遗物拍卖后被世界发现，成为业余摄影的传奇。
noteEn: A nanny's hidden lifetime of street genius, discovered at auction — the legend of the amateur rediscovered.

title: 最后的度假地
creator: Martin Parr
note: 新布莱顿海滨的明艳庸常，用「俗艳」戳破英国的阶级与度假神话。
noteEn: The gaudy, ordinary seaside of New Brighton — garishness puncturing Britain's myths of class and holiday.

title: 我的窗外
creator: Gail Albert Halaban
note: 长焦隔着窗户拍摄都市邻居的生活片段，把窥视变成带有距离的温柔。
noteEn: Telephoto glimpses of neighbors through windows — voyeurism made tender by distance.

title: 鲁道夫·伯克哈特：纽约
creator: Rudolph Burckhardt
note: 毕生拍摄纽约街景的「城市诗人」，用轻快的构图见证都市的日常诗意。
noteEn: A lifelong chronicler of New York street life — light compositions catching the everyday poetry of the city.

title: 在街上
creator: Helen Levitt
note: 哈莱姆儿童在街头游戏的黑白影像，把城市街头拍成孩子主宰的剧场。
noteEn: Children at play in Harlem's streets — the urban sidewalk as a theater ruled by kids.

title: 动物
creator: Garry Winogrand
note: 动物园里人与动物面面相觑的荒诞瞬间，城市人目光的绝妙人类学。
noteEn: People and animals staring each other down at the zoo — brilliant anthropology of the urban gaze.

title: 早期彩色
creator: Saul Leiter
note: 1950年代纽约彩色街头被尘封半世纪后才出版，色块与倒影的绘画感改写街头摄影。
noteEn: 1950s New York color unseen for half a century — color fields and reflections that redefined street photography.

title: 午夜前
creator: Trent Parke
note: 澳洲盛夏黄昏的奇异光线与城市幽灵，把「家国」拍成末日将至的寓言。
noteEn: Strange light and urban phantoms of an Australian summer — a homeland as a fable of approaching dusk.

title: 光的苦痛
creator: Alex Webb
note: 三十年跨洲街头的复杂构图，色彩在拥挤与孤独间绷到极限。
noteEn: Three decades of intricate color street across continents — color stretched between density and solitude.

title: 伊斯坦布尔
creator: Ara Güler
note: 「伊斯坦布尔之眼」半个世纪的黑白街影，为一个正在消逝的城市留下灵魂。
noteEn: Half a century of black-and-white streets from the "Eye of Istanbul" — the soul of a vanishing city.

title: 拉瓦尔
creator: Joan Colom
note: 巴塞罗那红灯区的偷拍式街头快照，粗野直接，堪称西班牙街头摄影的孤峰。
noteEn: Sneaky, raw street flashes from Barcelona's red-light Raval — a lone peak of Spanish street photography.

title: 停火
creator: Michael Schmidt
note: 冷战后期的柏林市井与人像，严谨克制地记录分裂城市的日常生活。
noteEn: Everyday Berlin life and faces in the late Cold War — a rigorous record of a divided city.

title: 在博克斯堡
creator: David Goldblatt
note: 南非白人小镇的日常细节，把种族隔离社会的「正常」拍得令人不安。
noteEn: Everyday detail of a white South African town — the "normal" of apartheid made unsettling.

title: 内罗毕城市
creator: Mutua Matheka
note: 以现代建筑与滑板青年重塑非洲首都的视觉形象，突破西方视角的单一想象。
noteEn: Modern towers and skateboarders reframing an African capital — pushing past the single Western image of Africa.

title: 99美分
creator: Andreas Gursky
note: 超市货架的万花筒式俯视，把消费主义景观拍成无限重复的数字矩阵。
noteEn: A kaleidoscopic supermarket interior — consumerist spectacle as an endlessly repeated digital matrix.
